title: Whole-Farm Trading Allowance on the Protected Floor of a Refined Fuels Pre-Buy Booking
content:
The floor a pre-buy booking on an account under Refined Fuels and Propane Accounts is protected at is raised where the member brings the cooperative the rest of their farm's business. What the member hauled into the grain division decides which line applies, taken together with the gallons booked on the account.

1. Where the member's grain deliveries over the twelve months ending on the handling date reach 40000 bushels and the gallons booked on the account reach the programme's minimum pre-buy gallons, the protected floor is the programme's floor percentage raised by 3.0 percentage points, taken on the price the gallons were booked at.
2. Where those grain deliveries fall under 40000 bushels and the gallons booked reach the programme's minimum pre-buy gallons, the protected floor is the programme's floor percentage raised by 1.5 percentage points, taken on the price the gallons were booked at.
3. Where the gallons booked fall under the programme's minimum pre-buy gallons, the protected floor is the programme's floor percentage, taken on the price the gallons were booked at, and no allowance is added.

## Where the bushels are read from

The bushel figure is the net bushels the member delivered and had applied against their Grain Marketing Contracts in the twelve months ending on the handling date — the scale tickets applied on that side of the cooperative, taken across the member's grain deliveries rather than any one contract. The gallons figure is the gallons booked on the energy account itself.

## The three lines, on both sides of each boundary

| Grain delivered in the window | Gallons booked | Floor percentage used |
| --- | --- | --- |
| 40000 bushels or more | At or above the programme's minimum pre-buy gallons | The programme's floor percentage plus 3.0 |
| Fewer than 40000 bushels | At or above the programme's minimum pre-buy gallons | The programme's floor percentage plus 1.5 |
| Any figure | Below the programme's minimum pre-buy gallons | The programme's floor percentage, unaltered |

*Hypothetical.* A member on a programme whose catalogue floor percentage is 90 percent has 40000 bushels exactly applied in the window and gallons booked at the programme's minimum exactly. The first line governs on both boundaries, so the floor percentage used is 93.0 percent. Had the bushels been 39999 with the same gallons booked, the second line would govern and the floor percentage used would be 91.5 percent. Had the gallons booked fallen one gallon short of the minimum, the third line would govern whatever the bushels, and the floor percentage would be 90 percent.
